title: Farthest velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the velocity magnitude at maximum distance from slope as 5v₀/3.

title: Landing velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed upon impact on the slope as (√73/3)v₀.

title: Landing angle tangent
description: Essential: Correctly determines tan(α) = v_y/v_x for the landing velocity as 8/3.

title: Horizontal displacement (part 3)
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the horizontal displacement x₁ as (96/41)h.

title: Vertical displacement (part 3)
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the vertical displacement y₁ as (36/41)h.

title: Slope geometry application
description: Important: Uses the slope angle (tan θ = 4/3) to relate projectile coordinates (y/x = 4/3) for landing time.

title: Perpendicular impact condition
description: Important: For part 3, applies the condition that the velocity upon impact is perpendicular to the slope (v_y/v_x = 3/4).

title: Projectile motion equations
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematic equations (x = v₀t, y = ½gt²) for horizontal and vertical motion.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of projection (left/right) or mishandles signs in coordinate setup.

title: Trigonometric confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses the slope angle (e.g., uses sin or cos instead of tan for the geometric condition).
